name: CT secondary terminal identification boundary
summary: Links the field CT circuit to the panel terminal and relay-channel identifiers.
description: Links the field CT circuit to the panel terminal and relay-channel identifiers. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Field secondary conductors” at the input and “Panel measurement identification” at the output. Labels must preserve core and phase identity.
